description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LeaveEntitlementUsage within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It models the usage details of leave entitlement, including id, number of days, days used, date range, and length of days.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementUsage
classes.description: A DTO class representing leave entitlement usage details, including IDs, date range, and days info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing all properties: id, noOfDays, daysUsed, fromDate, toDate, and lengthDays.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave entitlement usage record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave entitlement usage record.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of days for the entitlement.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the total number of days for the entitlement.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of days used from the entitlement.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of days used.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Gets the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Gets the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Retrieves the length of days, defaulting to zero if not specified.
